title: Long Brazil into Sunday's first-round vote, out at Monday's close

orders.Place_Note: MOC parent with a time exit only

thesis: Brazil holds its general election first round on Sunday 10/4, and every US midterm October since 2002 has carried the same weekend, which is what the EWZ midterm cell is really measuring. In all six first rounds the market-friendly main candidate finished above his final Datafolha number, and the size of that miss tracked the Thursday-to-Monday EWZ move (correlation 0.89). This cycle Lula polls about 45-46% of valid votes, short of an outright win, with roughly 13% parked with minor right-leaning candidates who consolidate late in a first round. On the other side are hedgers paying for protection into the vote (the Ibovespa fear index printed a record 32 on 9/28) and anyone taking the published polls at face value. Size is 15 bps because this is a six-observation cycle cell, and the sizing distance is 6 ATR because an election weekend gaps a fixed 5-12% that does not scale with today's low ATR.

evidence.summary: Thursday close to Monday close over the six first rounds (2002-2022): EWZ +4.40%, 5-1, sign p 0.109; EWZ minus EEM +5.60%, 5-0 (p 0.031; 5-1 if 2002 is filled with an EM country basket). Drop-best +2.81%, drop-two-best +1.30% 3-1, no sign flip. The same weekend in the 19 non-election years paid +0.72% 13-6, and the first October session in non-election years -0.52% 9-10, so there is no general early-October Brazil drift. All 16 entry/exit neighbours positive. Branches today: SPY near-high years 2006 and 2018 paid +1.42% and +7.18%; firm-dollar years 2014 and 2022 paid +8.87% and +12.36%. The 2002 loser (-4.98%) was global beta: the EM basket fell 4.21% that weekend. A pitch registry entry (09-29) killed the first-round trade for lacking the poll-miss side; this version measures it (6-0) and exits before the 10/25 runoff, where EWZ minus EEM was only 3-2.
evidence.control: EWZ all days +0.10%; the same weekend in non-election years +0.72%; EWZ minus EEM

survived: Crowding. Foreign money and at least one large bank are already positioned for a Flavio rally, but 2018 entered after a +17.1% 21-day run-in and still paid +7.18%; today's run-in is +3.4% over 21 days and -0.3% over 5.
what_kills_it: A Sunday count with Lula at 48% or more of valid votes and Flavio at 42% or less. The one loser, 2002, opened Monday -4.62% and closed -4.98% from Thursday, about 2.4 ATR at today's ATR; take the Monday MOC as planned and do not hold for the runoff.
overlap: None. No Brazil or EM exposure in the staged book, the event sleeve or the trend sleeve (CASH). Friday's payrolls print sits inside the hold.

title: Short long bonds for the first ten sessions of October, out after CPI

orders.Place_Note: MOC entry with a price stop/target — the fill price is not knowable at placement time

thesis: Long Treasuries have lost ground over the first ten sessions of October in 19 of 24 years since 2002, and October ranks first of twelve months for a short from the first session. The cell holds outside the cycle (midterm 5-1, other years 14-4), in every era and at every entry offset from -3 to +3 sessions, so the calendar carries it and the midterm adds nothing. The consensus read of a 21-day bond washout like today's (TLT 21d return rank 0.4) is a reflex bounce, and the dip buyers and duration-extension bids are the other side; washouts have not reverted at 10 to 21 sessions (-0.12% on 30-32 against +0.34% drift) and Octobers that opened from one were 7-1 for the short. No flow mechanism survived its control (quarter-start months are flat), and SPY sits in the near-high branch where the edge halves, so this is a statistical calendar trade sized at the 15 bps floor. The exit lands after CPI on 10/14 and PPI on 10/15.

evidence.summary: Short TLT from the first October close, 10 sessions, 2002-2025: +1.71%, 19-5, sign p 0.0033, t 3.40, against own drift -0.16%; October first of 12 months at h5, h10 and h21. ^TNX rose over the window 19-7 (2000-2025) and IEF short is 18-6; the residual against 1.91x IEF is +0.32% 15-9, so this is a rates-level trade. Rule 4: SPY near its high +0.85% 8-3 (p 0.11, today's branch) against off-high +2.38% 10-2; the pre-declared washout branch (TLT 21d rank 20 or lower, today 0.4) is 7-1. Last 10 years 8-2. Multiplicity: the cell was named before the calendar sweep, and charging the side flip and gate drop (x4) leaves p near 0.013. Re-anchored on the payrolls-eve close it is +1.75% 19-4.
evidence.control: TLT own drift over the same span (-0.16%); the same first-session window in the other eleven months; IEF and ^TNX
evidence.era_note: 2002-09 7-1, 2010-17 5-3, 2018-25 7-1; leave-one-year-out minimum +1.50%; top two years carry 29%

survived: The Thursday decomposition. One checker found the October return clustered on Thursdays and killed it; a within-year weekday permutation puts the best-weekday share at p 0.17, and non-Thursday October sessions alone pay +0.99% 17-7, still first of twelve months.
what_kills_it: SPY falling while bonds rally in the first five sessions: when SPY fell in the window the short earned only +0.06%, 5-3. Losers were flat at day 5 (+0.05%) and finished -1.56% at day 10; the worst, 2014, was 1 ATR against by day 5 and -3.64% at day 10 after a flash rally. A TLT close 1 ATR above the fill by 10/8 is that path, and the 3 ATR buy-stop is the exit.
overlap: Nothing in the book holds Treasuries. Today the 63-day correlation of short TLT with SPY is -0.49, so it hedges the equity side rather than adding to it; event sleeve T2 (short SPY) starts after this exits. TLT went ex its October distribution today, before the short opens, and the next ex-date (11/02) is after the exit. Today's pitch killed overnight TLT trades across payrolls; this is a ten-session calendar hold, a different construction.

reason: Thirteen candidates across ten asset classes and six axes; eleven died. The 63d rank clusters in utilities, regional banks and insurers were the index's or sector's fourth quarter (XLU minus SPY +0.04% 13-13) or lived in the off-high branch SPY is not in today. The crude, silver, semis and lab shorts died on a dead last decade, a zero gold residual or two-year concentration, and the 984-row calendar grid was chance after multiplicity. The third slot stays empty rather than holding a near-miss.
